title: A stabilizer interpretation of the (extended) linearized double shuffle Lie algebra
summary: The linearized double shuffle Lie algebra introduced by Brown reflects the depth-graded structure of multiple zeta values. In a previous paper, the first author introduced an extension of this Lie algebra that accommodates multiple q-zeta values and multiple Eisenstein series. Inspired by the stabilizer interpretation of the double shuffle Lie algebra given by Enriquez and Furusho, we provide in this paper a stabilizer interpretation of both Lie algebras and show that the stabilizers preserve the extension from the first linearized Lie algebra to the second one.
